title: How the Number Was Made
endLine: Before you read a pair, know what the assay measured.

scenes.tts: Read a trophic hormone with its target hormone, and the pair points to the failing link. Now take a healthy adult whose T S H reads low and free T four reads high. That pattern says overactive thyroid. So where did it come from?
scenes.narration: Read a trophic hormone with its target hormone, and the pair points to the failing link. Now take a healthy adult whose TSH reads low and free T4 reads high. That pattern says overactive thyroid. So where did it come from?
scenes.caption: Read a trophic hormone with its target hormone, and the pair points to the failing link. Now take a healthy adult whose TSH reads low and free T4 reads high. That pattern says overactive thyroid. So where did it come from?
scenes.visual: Continue the first film's 16:9 world and colour map without a reset. COLOUR BY CONCEPT, as before: PURPLE releasing signal; YELLOW trophic hormone (here TSH); ORANGE target hormone (here free T4); BLUE long-loop feedback; TEAL blood sample, assay, measurement; RED failure; GREEN intact; GREY outlines. New in this film: MAGENTA = biotin; WHITE glow = the signal tag an assay counts. LAYOUT, kept all film: the first film's row of three blocks, relabelled for the thyroid ('Hypothalamus', 'Anterior pituitary', 'Thyroid'), shrunk into a strip across the top (about y 2.6 to 3.4) with its BLUE feedback bar; the first film's two bar gauges at RIGHT (YELLOW 'TSH', ORANGE 'free T4', bars 'not to scale'); a large TEAL-outlined panel labelled 'the assay' filling the LEFT 60% of the frame below the strip, empty for now. On the first sentence, the strip glows in order (PURPLE, YELLOW arrow, ORANGE arrow, BLUE bar) as a recap. On 'healthy adult', the Thyroid block gets a GREEN outline and a small GREEN tick. On 'T S H reads low', the YELLOW bar sinks low; on 'free T four reads high', the ORANGE bar rises high. On 'overactive thyroid', a tag between the bars reads 'looks overactive'. On the question, a TEAL tube labelled 'one blood sample' drops into the empty assay panel and white text across the panel reads 'Where did this come from?' The GREEN tick keeps pulsing gently.

Title 'How the Number Was Made' fades in over the assay panel for 2 s while the question text fades out. The two bars keep their low TSH and high free T4 levels with a slight shimmer; the TEAL tube tilts and pours into the panel floor.

scenes.tts: The answer lies in how each number was made. For T S H, a large peptide, two antibodies grip one molecule. One holds it down, the other carries a signal. More hormone, more signal.
scenes.narration: The answer lies in how each number was made. For TSH, a large peptide, two antibodies grip one molecule. One holds it down, the other carries a signal. More hormone, more signal.
scenes.caption: The answer lies in how each number was made. For TSH, a large peptide, two antibodies grip one molecule. One holds it down, the other carries a signal. More hormone, more signal.
scenes.visual: The assay panel splits into two wells side by side, left labelled 'sandwich: TSH', right labelled 'competitive: free T4' (right well stays dim this scene). A TEAL floor line runs under both wells, labelled 'capture surface'. Both hormones are measured with antibodies here. A TEAL 'signal' meter, a vertical bar, stands at the right edge of each well (schematic, no numbers). In the sandwich well: simple TEAL Y-shaped antibody icons (icons, not molecular structures) stand on the floor; large YELLOW TSH dots drift down from the sample and each is gripped by one floor Y; on 'the other carries a signal', a second TEAL Y with a WHITE glowing tag lands on top of each YELLOW dot. On 'More hormone, more signal', more YELLOW dots arrive, more WHITE tags settle, and the sandwich well's signal meter rises. Labels: 'capture', 'signal'.

scenes.tts: Free T four is too small for two antibodies at once, so it is usually measured competitively. Sample hormone and a labelled copy compete for a limited antibody. More sample hormone, less label bound, so signal falls as hormone rises.
scenes.narration: Free T4 is too small for two antibodies at once, so it is usually measured competitively. Sample hormone and a labelled copy compete for a limited antibody. More sample hormone, less label bound, so signal falls as hormone rises.
scenes.caption: Free T4 is too small for two antibodies at once, so it is usually measured competitively. Sample hormone and a labelled copy compete for a limited antibody. More sample hormone, less label bound, so signal falls as hormone rises.
scenes.visual: The sandwich well dims but stays; the competitive well brightens. On 'too small', one small ORANGE free T4 dot sits between two TEAL Y icons that cannot both reach it; they bump and back off. Then only four TEAL Y icons stand on the floor of this well, labelled 'limited antibody'. Small plain ORANGE dots (sample) and small ORANGE dots with a WHITE glowing tag (labelled copy) jostle for the four sites. On 'More hormone in the sample', extra plain ORANGE dots pour in and push the tagged copies off the sites; the tagged dots float away. This well's TEAL signal meter falls. Labels: 'sample', 'labelled copy'. A small tag 'signal down = hormone up' appears under the meter.

scenes.tts: Some assays catch the antibody complex with biotin and streptavidin. A biotin supplement can block that catch. Less complex is captured, so the signal falls in both assays.
scenes.narration: Some assays catch the antibody complex with biotin and streptavidin. A biotin supplement can block that catch. Less complex is captured, so the signal falls in both assays.
scenes.caption: Some assays catch the antibody complex with biotin and streptavidin. A biotin supplement can block that catch. Less complex is captured, so the signal falls in both assays.
scenes.visual: Both wells at equal brightness. On 'biotin and streptavidin', the TEAL capture floor under both wells is relabelled 'streptavidin catch', and each antibody complex hooks onto it by a small hook. On 'A biotin supplement', a stream of small MAGENTA dots labelled 'biotin' pours in from the sample tube and settles along the floor of BOTH wells, filling the hook points. On 'Less complex is captured', several sandwich complexes (YELLOW dot with WHITE-tagged Y) and several tagged ORANGE complexes slide off the floor and drift away. On 'signal falls in both', both TEAL signal meters drop together. No numbers; 'schematic' tag at the panel corner.

scenes.tts: Now each assay turns signal into a concentration. In the sandwich assay, less signal reads as less T S H. In the competitive assay, less signal reads as more free T four. Together they draw an overactive thyroid that is not there.
scenes.narration: Now each assay turns signal into a concentration. In the sandwich assay, less signal reads as less TSH. In the competitive assay, less signal reads as more free T4. Together they draw an overactive thyroid that is not there.
scenes.caption: Now each assay turns signal into a concentration. In the sandwich assay, less signal reads as less TSH. In the competitive assay, less signal reads as more free T4. Together they draw an overactive thyroid that is not there.
scenes.visual: From each low TEAL signal meter, a TEAL arrow runs right to the matching gauge. On 'less T S H', the sandwich arrow carries the low signal to the YELLOW 'TSH' bar, which stays low, and a tag 'reads low' appears. On 'more free T four', the competitive arrow passes through a small flip icon (signal down = hormone up) and the ORANGE 'free T4' bar is pushed high, tag 'reads high'. On 'overactive thyroid', the tag 'looks overactive' between the bars returns; on 'not there', the GREEN-outlined Thyroid block in the top strip pulses with its GREEN tick, and the 'looks overactive' tag gets a TEAL frame labelled 'from the assay'. MAGENTA dots stay on the well floors.

scenes.tts: In a twenty twenty study, ten healthy adults took biotin daily for a week. Two hours after the last dose, one platform read lower T S H and higher free T four than baseline. Another platform's tested assays showed no significant change.
scenes.narration: In a 2020 study, ten healthy adults took biotin daily for a week. Two hours after the last dose, one platform read lower TSH and higher free T4 than baseline. Another platform's tested assays showed no significant change.
scenes.caption: In a 2020 study, ten healthy adults took biotin daily for a week. Two hours after the last dose, one platform read lower TSH and higher free T4 than baseline. Another platform's tested assays showed no significant change.
scenes.visual: The assay panel compresses into two small machine icons side by side, both TEAL, labelled 'platform 1' and 'platform 2'; a small tag above reads '2020: 10 healthy adults'. A row of ten simple person icons (GREEN outlines) sends a MAGENTA dot to each machine. Under 'platform 1', two mini bars show arrows: YELLOW TSH down, ORANGE free T4 up. Under 'platform 2', the same two mini bars stay level with a tag 'no significant change'. The large gauges at right echo platform 1 and then dim slightly.

scenes.tts: Here is the one idea. A hormone number is what the assay detected. That is not always what the blood holds, or what a receptor sees. So before you read a pair, ask what the assay measured.
scenes.narration: Here is the one idea. A hormone number is what the assay detected. That is not always what the blood holds, or what a receptor sees. So before you read a pair, ask what the assay measured.
scenes.caption: Here is the one idea. A hormone number is what the assay detected. That is not always what the blood holds, or what a receptor sees. So before you read a pair, ask what the assay measured.
scenes.visual: The two platform icons merge back into the full TEAL assay panel. The two gauges brighten again. A TEAL bracket labelled 'what the assay detected' wraps both gauges. On 'what the blood holds', the TEAL tube glows beside the panel with a small '?' ; on 'what a receptor sees', a small GREEN receptor cup icon appears beside the Thyroid block in the top strip with a '?'. On 'ask what the assay measured', both '?' marks fade, and white text appears below the gauges: 'ask what the assay measured'. Biotin dots fade from the wells; the wells reset to clean, idle antibodies on the floor.

scenes.tts: Nearly all T four in blood rides on carrier proteins. Only the free part is considered available to tissues. Oral estrogen raises thyroxine-binding globulin, so total T four rises. What do free T four and T S H do?
scenes.narration: Nearly all T4 in blood rides on carrier proteins. Only the free part is considered available to tissues. Oral estrogen raises thyroxine-binding globulin, so total T4 rises. What do free T4 and TSH do?
scenes.caption: Nearly all T4 in blood rides on carrier proteins. Only the free part is considered available to tissues. Oral estrogen raises thyroxine-binding globulin, so total T4 rises. What do free T4 and TSH do?
scenes.visual: The assay panel becomes a view inside the blood sample: a TEAL-outlined pool. Many ORANGE T4 dots ride on GREY rounded carrier shapes labelled 'carrier protein'; only a few ORANGE dots swim loose, labelled 'free'. The gauge row at right gains a third, faded ORANGE outline bar labelled 'total T4' to the left of the two existing bars; the YELLOW TSH and ORANGE free T4 bars return to mid level, labelled 'usual'. On 'Oral estrogen', more GREY carrier shapes appear in the pool, each loaded with ORANGE dots; the faded 'total T4' bar rises (schematic). On the question, the ORANGE 'free T4' bar and YELLOW 'TSH' bar each get a '?' and white text across the top: 'Free T4? TSH?'

Predict pause. The question 'Free T4? TSH?' stays. Carrier shapes drift slowly in the pool, a few free ORANGE dots swim between them, the 'total T4' bar sits raised; the free T4 and TSH bars hold still with their '?' marks. No other change.

scenes.tts: Free T four stays near its usual range, and T S H stays normal. Pair T S H with total T four, and the rule seems broken. Pair it with free T four, and the rule holds.
scenes.narration: Free T4 stays near its usual range, and TSH stays normal. Pair TSH with total T4, and the rule seems broken. Pair it with free T4, and the rule holds.
scenes.caption: Free T4 stays near its usual range, and TSH stays normal. Pair TSH with total T4, and the rule seems broken. Pair it with free T4, and the rule holds.
scenes.visual: The '?' marks dissolve. The free T4 bar stays at 'usual' (a small band around it reads 'near usual'); the TSH bar stays at 'usual'. In the pool, the count of loose free ORANGE dots stays about the same as before. On 'Pair T S H with total T four', a TEAL link line joins the YELLOW TSH bar to the raised 'total T4' bar and a small RED tag 'rule seems broken' appears; on 'Pair it with free T four', the link line swings to the free T4 bar, the RED tag fades, and a GREEN tag 'rule holds' appears.

scenes.tts: Back to our healthy adult. Rerun the same blood on a platform without a biotin step. A real change should show on both platforms, an artefact only on one. The pair still points to the failing link, once you know how each number was made.
scenes.narration: Back to our healthy adult. Rerun the same blood on a platform without a biotin step. A real change should show on both platforms, an artefact only on one. The pair still points to the failing link, once you know how each number was made.
scenes.caption: Back to our healthy adult. Rerun the same blood on a platform without a biotin step. A real change should show on both platforms, an artefact only on one. The pair still points to the failing link, once you know how each number was made.
scenes.visual: The blood pool folds back into the two-well assay panel from the start of the film. The TEAL tube splits into two portions: one goes to a well whose floor is labelled 'biotin catch', with MAGENTA dots, and its gauges read 'TSH low, free T4 high'; the other goes to a second well labelled 'no biotin step', where the floor stays clean and both gauges settle at 'usual'. On 'artefact only on one', the first result gets a TEAL frame labelled 'artefact'. On 'points to the failing link', the top thyroid strip glows in order, PURPLE, YELLOW, ORANGE, BLUE, with the Thyroid block's GREEN tick steady.

End card over the dimmed but still moving world (the thyroid strip glowing softly, a few ORANGE dots drifting in the assay panel, gauges at 'usual'). Large white text, centred: 'Before you read a pair, know what the assay measured.'
